text:
TS3 needs a longer fitting budget
Longer training improved fitting, but torsion remained above 10% stress error
notes: Source: short diagnostic baseline logs reported evaluation at800updates on506_533/ver and506_25/tor, stopped at897updates. Original long TS3 parent:5,000epochs/10,000updates, best9900 previously reported u0.5768%/2.2882%,stress5.5437%/11.5111%. Different runs and budgets, not an architecture-only comparison. Official source unchanged. Input28 basic coordinate/BC/material features, uXYZ plus source signed stress. Parent wall time about5.09h, actual training about4.77h.

text:
Stress tails remain strong after scaling
Vertical case: the top 1% of nodes carry 24% of standardized stress target energy
notes: Source:evaluations/processed_direct_statistics/statistics.json and original processed-target plot. Linear pooled fitting-case scaling. Vertical max|z|16.4053 and top1% standardized stress target energy23.9874%. These energy shares describe targets relative to zero standardized output, not prediction errors. Stress contributes26.7% of four-channel target energy, so it does not dominate the entire multitask loss.

notes: Limitations grounded in this experimental record. Currentsharedhashgrid useslocalcoordinates andbasicBCbroadcast, without a globalgeometryencoder. Potentialgeometryambiguity is a hypothesis, not proven cause. OneconditionperCAD in50subset confoundsCAD andBC. NGP capacity andsampling budgets differ from TSmodels and earlier smallNGP. Numerictransforms and losses differ, so comparedecodedphysicalerrors. Source signedstress lacksfulltensor, cannot inferVM. Reusedheldoutforselection inearlierphases provides noindependentfinaltest. Nextdiagnostics proposed only, not launched.
